Before installation, Messages verifies the APK size, checksum when supplied by GitHub, package name, version and signing certificate. Android always asks you to confirm installation.
The selected transport controls sending only. Receiving is detected automatically from the incoming message.

Files will be split into many Data SMS messages and can only be received by this app. Carrier SMS charges may apply. Receiving remains automatic and does not require the other person to select the same outgoing transport.

Media protocol packets will be encoded as ordinary multipart SMS. Secure-chat media stays encrypted. This works with more carriers, but may appear as encoded text in another SMS app and usually uses more billable SMS than Data SMS.
Connect your own server, Yandex Disk, or Google Drive before choosing this transport.

The file is encrypted before upload. A scoped link and file key are sent through the app control channel. Without an established secure chat that control data is not end-to-end protected. The recipient needs this app, but does not need your storage account.
